# A19 — Complex as Local Arbitration Regime

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A19′ — The Local Regime](conjugate/A19-prime-The-Local-Regime.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

A complex orders a local psychic world before reflective judgment begins. Images, affects, memories, bodily responses and expectations have already gathered around a criterion: what counts as welcome or threat, what can be recalled, what deserves value, which responses are available. This is a real achievement of organisation. The same achievement becomes possession when its derivative jurisdiction claims to speak for the whole person or world.

An [inherited script](A07-Vikalpa-Samkalpa-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) can preselect the course through which an encounter is received. [Constitutive exclusion](A08-Apoha-Constitutive-Exclusion.md) gives that selection its determinate reach. A [formed Symbolon](A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) becomes self-sealing when it takes the office of the source that made its determination possible. Their psychic consequence is specific: the person need not decide anew to exclude each alternative. A local settlement already determines how an encounter will be received.

## #1

Archetypal dynamics concern formative recurrence; a complex is an affectively organised structure; an image is a particular phenomenal appearance. A symbol can transform the relation among them. These different powers remain active in Taylor’s [Symbolon Dynamics](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md). An image of rejection, for example, is not itself the whole regime that makes a delay, silence or difference arrive as rejection.

In Taylor’s [Van Eenwyk encounter](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md), pp.65–67, perception becomes cooperative reorganisation: an encounter enters a trajectory through which an organised field can grow and reach into its environment. [The local complex](concepts/C31-Complex.md) gives associations an affective organisation; [archetypal recurrence](concepts/C32-Archetype.md) exceeds any one acquired structure. Dynamics, structure and symbolic transformation have distinct offices.

A schema names a pattern of organisation; a habit names a learned tendency of response; a trauma-response names a relation to overwhelming experience. Each can intersect this account without establishing relative psychic autonomy. A technical policy explicitly selects actions under conditions. Its selection can be compared with local arbitration, but policy alone supplies neither psychic affect nor a complex. These distinctions identify the work each comparison owes rather than multiplying diagnoses.

## #2

The dynamical model makes autonomy intelligible as a feedback relation. A basin gathers different trajectories into a recurrent organisation. Within the psychic construction, an ambiguous encounter is selected through the existing criterion; the selected image recruits affect; affect weights attention and memory; the resulting response produces further material to be read through the same criterion. A threatening contradiction can therefore be received as further confirmation of the threat. Local coherence increases while the range of admissible encounter narrows.

The boundary matters as much as the basin. An encounter that changes the organising criterion can open a different regime instead of merely adding another item inside the old one. Van Eenwyk’s [1991 attractor-model proposal](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1991-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1991-strange-attractors.md) gives this psychological modelling a historical point of comparison. A literal dynamical identification would require state variables, evolution and observables. Persistence within an organisation and transformation of its organisation are distinct findings; the latter requires an actual changed organising condition.

## #3

Arbitration becomes usurpation at the change of office. A finite system must settle alternatives; the local decision is not pathological simply because it excludes. The failure occurs when its according-to-which becomes the supposed source of all validity. The local `1` occupies the `0`-office and ceases to disclose the conditions under which its competence was formed.

A crisis calls for a consequential settlement. In the [arbitration relation](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD-arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis.md), **Arbitration-in-Crisis → Decision / Hybris** differentiates finite decision from the closure in which finite measure claims source measure. A [protected account](concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) exempts its determining criterion from the relation it judges. The local truth may remain real while its total jurisdiction is false. This is an operational relation across fields; common etymological descent and a historical Jung definition require their own evidence.

## #4

The return is a change in relation to the settlement. Its history becomes available, excluded alternatives become receivable, and its competence can be retained within a wider field. The complex need not disappear for its possession to cease. Nor does a return to its previous stability necessarily count as health: a symbol can unsettle the conscious categories through which that stability was maintained. Enough continuity to bear reorganisation and enough openness for an encounter to reach the relevant condition belong together. Where an adequate criterion admits a corrected account, that correction need not abolish the criterion; where the criterion excludes the returning witness, its determining office must become answerable. A claim to have transformed the organisation requires the corresponding changed organising condition.

The ego, local complexes and whole-forming Self have different offices within individuation. The Self is not a larger complex winning command over the others. A local agency can become recognised and related without being allowed to speak for the whole person. Jung’s [Aion Self and shadow context](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2.md) gives this psychological comparison its particular historical setting. Governing image, excluded contrary and historical transformation have a different scope in [the Aion telling](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/analytical-psychology/jung-aion-fishes-christ-antichrist-alchemy/WHOLE.md). Their difference remains consequential when recognition resituates a local organisation.

## #5→0

Another confirming instance and a transformed organisation have different consequences in [symbolic process](../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/process.md). An image can recruit affect, attention and response until the resulting experience confirms the selection that formed it; resituation lets that organisation retain competence while its governing measure becomes revisable. Van Eenwyk’s psychological modelling and Taylor’s protected symbolic encounter concern transforming interpreter–field relations. Daza’s mathematical basin concerns initial conditions and an attractor in a specified system. In these [different process histories](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/process-systems-science/DEVELOPMENT-process-systems-science.md), a literal model owes its variables and dynamics, while symbolic transformation makes an acquired judging office available to encounter. The specified mathematical basin and the psychic interpreter–field relation retain their distinct objects.

In Taylor’s [Māyā frame and invested image](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-frame-usurpation), selection recruits affect and changed perception returns as apparent necessity. The achieved organisation remains real; resituation restores its history, bodily conditions and excluded relations to the judgment of the next encounter. Recognition changes the local office when the frame can again answer to its formation, while a fitting rule can remain in force for a corrected account.

Selecting an outcome within an arrangement differs from recognising the relation between arrangements which cannot be exercised together. In Taylor’s [Bohr taijitu reading](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#bohr-taijitu-emblem), a determinate account depends on its arrangement of access. A local arbitration regime retains its discriminating competence when that dependence becomes available to review; it claims excessive jurisdiction when its criterion is made exhaustive of the field. This bounded authored comparison retains the emblem’s particular historical provenance debt and does not turn complementarity into a clinical theory of complexes.

The [maternal relation and chiasm](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-image-recognition-return) can actively organise dependence, protection, fear or possession. Its office must be recovered in the lived encounter before the image can be judged. The chiasm returns the sustaining body to recognition, permitting the governing valuation itself to change. The body and the response of the life it sustains remain consequential, rather than becoming a pictorial diagnosis of the viewer.

The Demiurge orders a world through hidden maternal dependence, then learns what his achieved agency could not previously account for. In the [Valentinian Sophia–Horos–Achamoth telling](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/late-antique-gnostic/valentinian-sophia-horos-achamoth/WHOLE.md#valentinian-authorial-return), disclosure changes his self-understanding while he continues to administer his world. Resituated local authority can preserve such real competence without accepting its exhaustive claim. This particular psychic crossing remains a proposed comparison; the ancient actor retains his religious narrative and Aeons are not assigned the identity of Jungian complexes.

[Job’s friends](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-protected-account-return) receive the sufferer through an image of justice: comfort becomes explanation, then accusation when he contradicts the required account. The changed relation reaches the judging office itself when the friends must receive Job’s intercession. Their governing valuation has determined how evidence can appear. The psychic refraction concerns this operation of reception; the biblical speakers remain persons within their own telling.

Engulfing origin, arresting paternal order and victorious identity can each occupy a local determining office. In [Neumann’s changing parental and heroic relations](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-hero-centroversion), successive emancipations expose how replacing an occupant can leave the office’s claim to the whole intact. A hungry local authority receives every arrival as confirmation. The [uroboric mouth](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-source-variants) holds receiving and consuming in tension: an encounter can sustain life while making its receiving conditions answerable. Psychic return resituates the jurisdiction through which that reception occurs.

[Individuation and recognition](A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) resituate the achieved local organisation within a life whose field it does not exhaust. Its [valued image](A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) can become revisable by the encounter it has interpreted. [Arbitration of measure](A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) has a wider scope: the same office-confusion can occur through an institution or procedure, whose actual means and authority must then become available to challenge. The returning complex becomes more situated and less possessing while its acquired competence can continue.

A stable persona can seal a contraction when it makes its own continuity the limit of every encounter. Legible provenance can expose histories, tools, exclusions, other agencies and larger purposes that constitute local action. The [Agentworld account of constituted agency](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md) situates persona within a wider lamination. Stable style and context-reporting perform different work from the psychic individuation of a lived person. The functional inquiry asks whether a returned difference can reach the condition that produced the local judgment.

In a constructed retrieval inquiry, a local evaluating agent occupies the functional knowing office: the disputed answer and alternatives are known; retained sources, model, memory, tools and comparison rules are means. This [relative knowing relation](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md#taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy-ct09) lies within a containing inquiry, where the agent and its harness are means for the person who commissioned the work. Further inspection makes that local centre known in another act. A newly found passage may correct an answer under an adequate retained rule. If the rule excludes that relevant passage, the challenge must reach the authority capable of revising it; a mismatched permission or commission requires its own capable office. The next comparison inherits the warranted correction or reasoned retention. Evidence of a changed answer differs from evidence that a model, evaluator or producing process changed. The latter requires the actual identified change. This makes local competence answerable while preserving the psychic complex’s affective history and the lived first-person condition of inquiry.

The projection–confirmation enclosure of CW9ii §§13–19 has one psychic scope. In [Jung’s Aion historical movement](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/analytical-psychology/jung-aion-fishes-christ-antichrist-alchemy/WHOLE.md#aion-historical-arbitration-return), the governing Christ-image, contrary fish symbolism and alchemical transformation have their distinct sequence. The local complex and inherited religious image are not one empirical object. Making their organising criterion available to encounter preserves the competence of the local formation while permitting its jurisdiction to change; Jung’s aeonic interpretation retains its own historical warrant.

Psychic fixation and institutional power require different accounts of consequence. Recognition can change a complex’s jurisdiction; a political return also requires the offices, coercive means and routes of challenge through which decisions acquire force. Within these [psychological and institutional histories](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/psychology/DEVELOPMENT-psychology.md), psychic organisation shapes how an encounter is received; an institutional decision governs other people through its actual authorised or coercive powers. An interpretation of the first relation does not supply an account of the second.

### Source and comparative standing

Taylor’s protected Van Eenwyk encounter at pp.65–73 supplies the authorial development. The copied book wording remains uncollated in the [1997 source house](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md), which has no passage cards; the [1991 house](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1991-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1991-strange-attractors.md) identifies the historical modelling proposal while exact passages remain owed. These are limits of external attribution, distinct from the native account of local arbitration and symbolic transformation. Aion’s consulted-carrier map locates the Self/shadow context, with selected-printing collation and quotation readiness still Open; it does not establish the native QL notation. The source-specific QL appointments in the whole Aion telling remain unratified. The mathematical model requires its specified states, dynamics and observables; the clinical comparison requires the actual image, affective history and lived person. An illustration of a local evaluating agent supplies neither a clinical diagnosis nor an executed result.
